description: This file defines extension methods for the Article entity related to data retrieval, specifically adding a method to fetch article data with related entities using Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: ArticleExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the Article entity related to data querying.

methods.name: GetAllData
methods.description: An extension method on DbSet<Article> to retrieve articles with related entities such as Author, ArticleFavorites, and ArticleTags, using eager loading and no tracking.
